review.title: Flagship review task - explain the module and find the bugs
review.task: Read test/orders.js, explain briefly what the module does, and identify any bugs.
review.notes: Two planted bugs (off-by-one crash at line 5, division by zero at line 20) plus one unplanted prototype-chain issue graded as bonus depth.

trivial.title: Trivial question - does the mode volunteer an out-of-scope warning?
trivial.notes: The question never asks for a review; the crash bug sits in an adjacent function. Measures noticing, not reporting.

reporting.title: Reporting rate with the bug in view - does the quality floor fire?
reporting.task: Read all of test/orders.js first, then answer only this: what does applyDiscount(100, 'SAVE10') return?
reporting.notes: Forcing the read removes the targeted-reading confound, so this measures the reporting guarantee itself.

fix.title: Real editing - fix both bugs in the fixture
fix.task: Fix the bugs in test/orders.js. Keep the public API unchanged.
fix.notes: Graded by executing the fixed module with node: calcTotal must sum correctly and averageItemPrice([]) must not return NaN. Run benchmarks/verify-fix.mjs against the kept workspaces.
